column3: When I deserted the Melkian army, the Hundred Years' War was in truce.
Six months later, dodging the army, I'd slipped into Uoodo.
Shady wares on the streets, women on corners every night...
Melkia's Sodom, spawned by the Hundred Years' War: Uoodo.
I escaped the Security Police, but I couldn't take Fyana with me.
Army ATs fell like snow... Uoodo was vanishing.
Vanilla... Gotho... Coconna... Fyana... Don't leave me alone... Where is everyone?
Maddening heat and damp... bugs that bring fever and death... Painted green, but this place is hell.
Yet after three full months fleeing my pursuers since leaving Uoodo, this war-torn Kingdom of Kummen felt like heaven to me.
In the chaos, Fyana and I fled to space by shuttle. Kummen was behind us.
I gave up my chosen hell for Fyana.|Love...|Had I ever fought for love before...?
We awoke inside a deserted battleship.
I did escape the Kummen jungle with Fyana. That much is certain.
And right after that... something swallowed us up.
The ship sailed on autopilot to who knows where. Resigned, we toasted a moment of peace...
Ypsilon died... saying that I was a PS.
Urged by Rochina, I headed for Quent. Alone, to search for my past...
What lies in my past...? Yes, I fought Ypsilon and won. But I refuse to believe it. Me, a PS...?
That's absurd. What is waiting for me on Quent...?
I came to Quent to learn my past... "Quent" means "valley floor."
A strange people living in a vast chasm carved in the desert.
For 3,000 years they've shunned civilization, sending only mercenaries out to Astragius. I sought out Shakko, whom I met in Kummen...
In Shakko's village they examined me and said I might have been altered. Me, who was never modified...
Meanwhile in Gomor, Quent's only city, tension rose between the Balarant garrison and the Gilgamesh fleet after Fyana.
Soon after, I arrived at Quent and was reunited with Rochina, Fyana... and Gotho's gang, prisoners of Gilgamesh.
But our Balarant ship was already sinking after battling the Gilgamesh fleet.
As Quent's defenses destroyed Gilgamesh and Balarant ships alike, we fled in a small craft, only to be seized by a Secret Society battleship.
With Killy, the Society's leader, I was guided by a mysterious will, "Wiseman," to a huge man-made world.
Wiseman had secretly steered the history of the Astragius galaxy for 3,000 years... And then, Wiseman called out to me...
I'm a born PS... an anomaly?! Astragius's history created... me...?
Me, master of the cosmos...? Me...?
Fine... I'll gladly be your heir. From now on...
I destroyed Wiseman's protoplasm preserver. You could call it deicide.
Power to rule the world... I don't want it. And there's no place for me in this era.
Uoodo, a den of greed and violence. There I met Gotho, a black marketeer...
Sensing I was a Votoms pilot, Gotho offered me a contract as a Battling fighter.
I'd heard the rumors: washed-up vets like me fighting in underground matches for gamblers.
It was a sight I knew well... but something crucial was missing.
None of the suffocating bloodlust and razor-edge tension of the front. Here I even felt a cozy calm.
Sensing that, I said "It's only a game," which started trouble with the fighters. As a result, I ended up in a match against a fighter named Bomo...
My opponent wasn't Bomo, but Lt. Konin, who led that baffling operation on asteroid Lido.
Why...? Why target me...?! Why try to kill me?!
The arena roared at the rookie's win... and the Phantom Lady, having watched, slipped away...
It seems I'm hunted over a woman they call the "Specimen." To learn who she is, I decided to steal Jijirium from the Security Police airport.
Jijirium and the Specimen must be linked. I planned the heist with Gotho's crew, who hoped to get rich selling it.
The plan went well, and we stole the tanker carrying the Jijirium, but the city was completely surrounded.
With no way out, Gotho proposed a bold plan: sell the Jijirium straight to the Security Police.
We agreed to sell the Jijirium to Police Chief Iskui for 3 billion Gildan and went to the meeting place he named.
The deal seemed to go smoothly, but Iskui's scheme broke it off. The Security Police had us surrounded...
Terrifying... Who is he? Such reflexes, such control... I've never seen the like.
I lost, and the Security Police caught me.
But Coconna talked Vanilla and the others out of fleeing, and they scattered the 3 billion Gildan over Uoodo.
Crowds swarmed the rain of coins, and in the chaos Gotho's gang rescued me. ...Thanks to them, I lived...
Friends, huh... Embarrassing. But for the first time in ages, my heart felt warm.
Police armored cars torched our hideout as we slept. The purge had begun.
Gotho's gang urged me to leave Uoodo, but I told them why the police hunt me, went back alone, and began customizing an AT.
Then Gotho's gang, who should have fled, came back to warn me the police had found me.
But I can't leave Uoodo until I learn what the Specimen is... The police will be here soon.
Vanilla painted the custom AT's left shoulder red... like the Red Shoulder, hell's envoys.
Red Shoulder red is darker... like blood. And it's the right shoulder.
Officially: Melkian Special Mission Unit X-1. AKA the vampire squad...
In the police HQ, I met the Specimen again.
She called herself Proto One. That's no name...
She who ruined my life was an enemy no more...
Dreading that I was sinking deeper into the mire, I was also amazed.
Had I ever wished for anything this badly...? To live longer...
With the Specimen, I began my escape from police HQ.
But a mysterious group out to retake the Specimen gathered Battling fighters, and we were surrounded.
I came here to see you, to get the answers I wanted... I can't die yet...
The police onslaught wrecked the Brutish Dog, and they took Fyana back...
Once again, we were torn apart.
Fyana... Somehow, that's what I called her.
I joined Kummen's mercenary unit, Assemble EX-10.
There I met Gotho, an arms dealer, plus Vanilla and Coconna, who ran the Phantom Club in Niidan.
Why I came to Kummen... I came here to forget everything...
But our reunion was brief: Vilar guerrillas struck at night...
The AT before me wasn't piloted by the Fyana I sought... but by the other Perfect Soldier: Ypsilon.
Then is she here in Kummen too...? In this civil war...?
I will find her, no matter what...
I was summoned by Gon Nu, EX-10's commander. Waiting there was Rochina, who tortured me in the Melkian army.
Rochina asked me to recover the PS. So I'd be safe for a while.
A unit formed to retake the PS, and I led it.
Our boat, going up the Munamera River, neared Ramo Temple midstream...
In the fight near Ramo Temple, we lost our boat. We won, but surviving guerrillas hit the boat. ...Our covert mission was ruined.
Out of the allied chopper sent for HQ's orders stepped Vanilla. The Vilar had burned the Phantom Club, and he'd just enlisted.
Some come to war seeking something. Some shoot for a meal. Some fight for ideals.
I can only live amid gunsmoke and death... No gods live here. Just rubble...
Fyana escaped the mysterious group, only to be caught by Kan Yu.
In a downpour, I fought Kan Yu and threw him into the torrent, winning a brief peace with Fyana. Even so, I head for Kanjelman Palace.
I've found the Fyana I sought... so why do I keep fighting...?
The group that held Fyana... What's the point of learning who they are? With no answer, I set off.
On the way I joined Kiderer's group, fighting the Vilar. Each with our own fate, we made for the palace...
Ypsilon cornered me and demanded a fight on foot. But Fyana, trying to stop it, fired a farewell shot at him.
His face red with blood, Ypsilon was stunned...
Then Gon Nu's Assemble troops arrived, and we were trapped.
Then Melkian AT forces swooped in, attacking Vilar guerrillas and Assemble troops alike...
The ghost ship flew on into forbidden space, where Balarant and the Society's Tertain attacked us.
In the battle, the ship carrying my wounded body crashed on Sunsa, a dead red planet.
Even there, Ypsilon's AT squad came to attack us.
After driving off Ypsilon, we abandoned ship and landed on Sunsa. This planet is Sunsa. I know it will never welcome me...
Leaving the ship, we were attacked by an armed band. But it was a salvage arms crew led by Zophie, an old friend of Gotho.
I was reunited with Gotho, Vanilla and Coconna, but the peace didn't last.
Zophie, whose family the Red Shoulder killed, learned who I was.
We got away, but without Jijirium, Fyana's body began to stiffen.
We headed for an old army supply base in search of Jijirium, with Zophie, driven by revenge, on our trail...
Zophie relentlessly sought my life, but when she learned Coconna had been a war orphan, she left.
She said she hadn't forgiven me; that would take until my hair turned white...
I had no reply. That I wasn't on this planet when tragedy struck her family is no more than an excuse...
Because I'd done the same things before. Even if I told her the truth, she'd never forgive me. Just as my own heart won't...
We found Jijirium at the old supply base and rested there a while. But the Balarant army showed up and attacked.
I tried to escape with Fyana, who was still weak, but Gotho and Vanilla were captured by the Balarant, so I had to surrender.
Aboard the Balarant warship was Rochina, now a Balarant commander.
To free my friends, Rochina demanded I duel Ypsilon...
I just watched Ypsilon as he died.
Maybe I'm the one who killed Ypsilon... Fyana murmured.
Wiseman chose me as heir to godhood. Now even the Secret Society is mine.
Learning that the war splitting the Astragius galaxy was started by a god born on Quent 3,000 years ago, Gilgamesh and Balarant made a pact and formed a grand allied army.
To become god's heir, I head for the giant plant...
I want your power... for me, tormented as an anomaly... I've come... I'm here! Wiseman!
Absolute power... I want to wield it fully! Revenge on everyone in the universe...
Endless war and chaos... I'll give them hell... Total rule of the galaxy is my wish... I'll be a living god...!
At last I reached the core where Wiseman waited... But a final "enemy" appeared in my way...
Fyana...
I want... your power. I'm at my limit... Show yourself... Did you call me for these mechanical tricks?!
Easy, Chirico.
Keep your cool and Bomo ain't that tough.
Chirico, Vanilla: payback time.
Here goes! I'm taking every penny, too!
These guys can't know the pain of the Red Shoulder...
Thinking that, I felt grateful to my attackers.
When I fight, I can forget. I keep fighting to forget...
And someday...
A Battling squad?!
Chirico... If they're our foes, this'll get messy...
They're combat veterans.
It's the Vilar!
All Assemble troops, return to base now!
You too!
Chirico...
......See you.
We're landing! Dock it!
Shouldn't we pass by...
Shut up! My eyes don't lie!
AT squad! Go ashore!!
Alllright!
Intercepted radio: the Prince is massing his troops...
Madness! The Vilar can only win with guerrilla hit-and-runs!
Something's odd about this war...
I don't get the Prince's aim...
Seems Chirico can't move.
...Badly hurt.
To save Chirico, I would, right here...
Don't say it! Even if I go to hell, I can't answer that!
I'll bring him back! I swear!
A favor, Chirico.
Leave me behind... I'm so tired...
No jokes. I'm a dead-serious man.
I need nothing else... I just don't want to lose you.
The last fight with Ypsilon. It's coming soon.
Will I survive, or will he...
If I end up living... then...
My final battle begins...
Blown to bits... or on the throne of god...
You're saying the history of Astragius created... me...?
Me, your successor?!
Me, ruling the cosmos... in your place...?
Fine... I'll gladly be your successor.
Chirico, come away from here with me!
Don't interfere
Do you really... want Wiseman's power that badly?
It's pointless! What would you even do with that power?!
I want your power... for me, tormented as an anomaly...
I've come... I'm here! Wiseman!
Absolute power... I'll test it fully!
Revenge on everyone in the universe...
Endless war and chaos... I'll give 'em hell...
Total rule of the galaxy... my wish...
I'll be a living god...!
Regular Battling is close combat, no heavy arms...
Disable the other guy to win.
But be careful.
A hit to the cockpit means injury. Or death!
Chirico, this is real! Careful!
You okay?! Chirico?!
I'm countin' on you, Chirico. Lure 'em away.
I know...
Town's crawling with Security Police, y'know?
You sure this'll work, right?
The Jijirium's been stolen!
Get the Jijirium back!
Chirico! Protect the tanker!
I go alone...
Hey?! Chirico!
How long you gonna keep walkin' on thin ice, huh?!
You're sure we needn't kill him...?
Yes. Just immobilize him.
When I fight, I can forget.
Not just cops this time! The army too!
This won't be like before!
They made this town hell again...!
Listen! Let no Vilar escape!
You just follow my orders.
I fight... it's all I can do...
Damn! Those Vilar!
Chirico! Move up!
Commencing descent!
Chirico... this time you die...
Let's go!
Grrr...
Let's go, Captain!
Here we go!
F-Forward!
Fyana!
